instruction: Highlight all dates that fall on the 15th of the month by setting the cell background as orange (#FFA500). Finish the work and don't touch irrelevant regions, even if they are blank.

metadata.explanation: Task requires highlighting dates that are the 15th day of any month in orange. Verified: 5 cells with date value having day=15.
metadata.verification: Verified by analyzing complete calendar data: 5 fifteenth_of_month cells identified with Python script from 153 total date cells.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical logic flaw: Evaluator checks hardcoded cell coordinates (B17, C17, D17, E17, F17) rather than dynamically identifying which cells contain dates with day=15
No date content verification: Getter only extracts colors, never validates that the expected cells actually contain 15th dates
Incomplete semantic verification: If user highlights different cells that contain actual 15th dates, evaluator would fail incorrectly
Missing negative verification: Does not check that non-15th date cells remain unhighlighted (user could highlight everything orange)
The evaluator assumes the expected cell list is correct but never verifies this assumption against actual cell date values
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Getter should extract BOTH cell colors AND cell values (dates) from the spreadsheet
Metric should: (1) Parse date values to identify which cells have day=15, (2) Verify those cells have orange background, (3) Verify non-15th cells do NOT have orange background
Remove hardcoded cell coordinates from expected; instead use dynamic logic to find 15th dates at runtime
Consider using openpyxl to read both cell.value and cell.fill in the getter to enable proper date-based verification
